institutions.name: High Admiralty Court of Forfeiture
institutions.mandate: Condemn illicit coastal cargo and direct heavy contraband directly into littoral breakwater construction.
institutions.decision_rule: Cargo exceeding legal tonnage or lacking excise chops is declared aggregate and ordered sunk into the nearest seawall sector.
institutions.visible_output: Terraced seawalls lined with stamped iron chests, seized vessel keels, and court placards.

institutions.name: Haven Slipway Guild
institutions.mandate: Maintain continuous intertidal ramp access and mooring rights for working fishercraft.
institutions.decision_rule: Quorum of master mariners can declare a court seawall section an unlawful blockage and erect pirate slipways.
institutions.visible_output: Improvised timber ramps spanning across newly raised seawall revetments.

institutions.name: Board of Riprap Assay
institutions.mandate: Certify the structural buoyancy and load-bearing density of confiscated property before shoreline interment.
institutions.decision_rule: High-density contraband is assigned to deep breakwaters; porous wood cargo is assigned to intertidal gabions.
institutions.visible_output: Color-coded chalk grids and salvage permits affixed to coastal aggregate heaps.

institutions.name: High Admiralty Court of Forfeiture
institutions.mandate: Condemn illicit coastal cargo and direct heavy contraband directly into littoral breakwater construction.

institutions.name: Haven Slipway Guild
institutions.mandate: Maintain continuous intertidal ramp access and mooring rights for working fishercraft.

institutions.name: Board of Riprap Assay
institutions.mandate: Certify the structural buoyancy and load-bearing density of confiscated property before shoreline interment.
institutions.decision_rule: High-density contraband is assigned to deep breakwaters; porous wood cargo is assigned to intertidal gabions.
